title: About keyword matching options
supports: Broad, phrase and exact match as they work now; broad match may use other signals; Google's advice to pair broad match with Smart Bidding; duplicate keywords

title: How AI Max for Search campaigns works
supports: AI Max is a layer inside Search campaigns: search term matching, text customisation, final URL expansion, locations of interest, brand and URL controls, AI Max reporting; weak when budget-limited; tracking template caution

title: Get greater control and smarter optimization with AI Max as it expands globally (10 September 2025)
supports: AI Max for Search available to all advertisers globally from 10 September 2025, still in beta; one-click experiments; text guidelines

title: Apply brand exclusions to Performance Max or Search campaigns
supports: Brand exclusions cover Search, Shopping and YouTube search inventory in Performance Max; option to allow Shopping ads on excluded brands; Search brand exclusions moving into AI Max from 27 May 2025

title: About the search terms report
supports: What the report shows; low-volume terms withheld for privacy; match type column; search terms insights use the last 56 days

title: About negative keywords
supports: Negative broad, phrase and exact; negatives do not match close variants; account-level negatives apply to Search and Shopping; terms after the 16th word

title: Negative keywords in Performance Max campaigns
supports: Campaign-level negatives and lists in Performance Max apply to Search and Shopping inventory only; account-level negatives also apply

title: About Performance Max campaigns
supports: Channels covered, asset groups, audience signals, search themes (same priority as phrase and broad keywords), final URL expansion, brand exclusions, conversion goal requirement

title: About the channel performance report
supports: Channel performance reporting for Performance Max and Demand Gen; statuses; how to read a channel with no spend

title: Google Ads Highlights of 2025 (8 December 2025)
supports: 2025 changes: Performance Max search terms and asset reporting, campaign negatives up to 10,000, search themes raised to 50 per asset group, Demand Gen controls, Meridian, Data Manager, lower conversion lift thresholds

title: About Target CPA bidding
supports: How Target CPA works, recommended targets from the last 30 days, evaluate on 30+ conversions, too-low targets lose conversions, renaming from June 2026

title: About Target ROAS bidding
supports: ROAS formula, conversion value requirement, minimum conversions by campaign type (15 in 30 days for Search and Shopping), high targets limit traffic, 1 to 2 conversion cycles to take effect

title: Changes to target based bid strategies
supports: From 17 August 2026, budget-limited Target CPA and Target ROAS campaigns deliver closer to the stated target; affected campaign types; Google's suggested options

title: About Smart Bidding Exploration
supports: Opt-in flexible Target ROAS to find new searches within existing targeting; not for budget-constrained campaigns; turn on at least 6 weeks before peak

title: About responsive search ads
supports: Up to 15 headlines (30 characters) and 4 descriptions (90 characters); pinning effects; at least 2 RSAs per ad group; Google internal results from August 2025

title: About Ad Strength for responsive search ads
supports: Ad Strength ratings; not used for Ad Rank, Quality Score or auction wins; avoid pinning unless necessary

title: About Quality Score for Search campaigns
supports: 1 to 10 diagnostic; expected CTR, ad relevance, landing page experience; not an auction input or a KPI

title: Ad Rank: Definition
supports: Ad Rank factors: bid, ad and landing page quality, thresholds, competition, search context, expected impact of assets; a better ad can outrank a higher bid

title: About overdelivery and your average daily budget
supports: Campaigns can spend up to twice the average daily budget on a day; monthly charges capped at 30.4 times the daily budget

title: About custom experiments
supports: Supported campaign types; 50/50 split controls eligibility, not equal spend; allow 7 to 14 days to stabilise; apply or convert results

title: About enhanced conversions
supports: Enhanced conversions for web and for leads; SHA-256 hashing of first-party data; setup through the Google tag, tag gateway or server-side Tag Manager

title: Consent mode (Google tag platform developer guide)
supports: The four consent types (ad_storage, analytics_storage, ad_user_data, ad_personalization); basic versus advanced consent mode and modelling; advertiser responsible for consent

title: About enhanced conversions for leads
supports: How enhanced conversions for leads works; Data Manager; web and leads settings combining (April 2026); offline uploads moving to the Data Manager API from 15 June 2026; keep sending GCLIDs

title: About primary and secondary conversion actions
supports: Primary actions fill the Conversions column and drive bidding; secondary actions are observation only; changes can trigger up to 7 days of learning

title: About attribution models
supports: First click, linear, time decay and position-based models no longer supported; DDA is the default; last click remains; the model affects bidding

title: About Demand Gen campaigns
supports: Channels (YouTube incl. Shorts, Discover, Gmail, Maps, Display Network); lookalike segments; daily budget of at least 10 times target CPA; Display campaigns moving into Demand Gen from June 2026

title: Product data specification
supports: Required product attributes and limits (title 150 characters, id 50, description 5,000); GTIN guidance; price and availability must match the landing page; 500 x 500 minimum image size from 31 January 2027

title: About Shopping ads
supports: Shopping ads use Merchant Center product data, not keywords; product groups; where they appear; bidding options

title: Consumer Heterogeneity and Paid Search Effectiveness: A Large Scale Field Experiment (NBER Working Paper 20171, May 2014)
supports: Blake, Nosko and Tadelis: eBay's brand keyword ads showed no measurable short-term benefit; non-brand ads mainly moved new and infrequent buyers; experimental returns far below non-experimental estimates

title: Search Advertising Benchmarks for Every Industry, 2026 data (updated 1 June 2026)
supports: All-industry search advertising averages for 2026: CPC, CTR, conversion rate and cost per lead
